Tag General

Trigger you begin a Parley

Duration that Parley

Take on a Toll cost willingly, before the ask, to guarantee a Parley's base effect lands without a check.

Before you Parley, you may take 1 point of Toll. That Parley's base effect occurs without a check: it is neither rolled for nor resisted, and it cannot critically succeed. Only the base effect is guaranteed — any part of the Parley you pushed for extra Toll is rolled normally, and a guaranteed Parley cannot itself be pushed.

cinderfall.incomplete: Guarantees a Parley's base effect happens automatically with no roll at all, not merely an upgraded result on an actual roll -- confirmed distinct from AdjustDegreeOfSuccess's real to-success adjustment (which still requires an actual check to occur and only reclassifies its result; it cannot skip the roll entirely). No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for "this check simply doesn't happen and its base effect occurs as if it succeeded." Also spends "1 Toll," which has zero rule-element representation anywhere in the corpus -- even the trigger condition can't be encoded.
